to: everyone near the character that poked (`xy_emit`): players and observers

fields.name: name
fields.description: The `name` of the request, unchanged. The server does not check it, so it can be any value, also a name that is not in view. Absent when the request has no `name` (the value is `undefined`, which JSON leaves out).

fields.name: level
fields.description: The strength, from the level of the `poker` gloves: 1 below +8, 2 at +8, 3 at +9, 4 at +10 and more.

senders.what: The `poke` handler: the character wears the `poker` gloves and poked fewer than 50 times in this session
